# Portfolio interaction reference

Source and rights scope: [portfolio provenance](jjoe-template/NOTICE.md).

Reusable patterns include dark backgrounds, adjustable accent colors, floating navigation, anchor links, image zoom, content dialogs, multi-page navigation, and collapsible steps. The editor implements these as independent blocks and appearance settings. It does not load the reference website or include its personal media and copy.

Dragging and sorting use dnd-kit. Keyboard controls and explicit apply buttons provide alternatives to dragging. Motion is simplified for reduced-motion preferences.
